title: Implement and test experimental station policy
description:
Implement and test the minimal isolated experimental station-policy integration for the single approved backend/profile. Consume the reviewed narrow.06 emission/control decision, narrow.07 callsign/control contract, narrow.08 traffic/privacy approval, and narrow.09 driver/profile support. Own or verify and reuse the actual policy producer, not only its tests: identification scheduling including communication end, control/shutdown behavior, overload and missing-configuration rejection, permitted traffic filtering and configured frequency/power constraints. Keep unsupported or unapproved modes disabled; do not silently strip OSCORE, weaken production security, or activate RF. Then exercise the production station-policy path using independent event tables and driver-call observations. No new general station-control framework is required.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design:
Require affirmative narrow.06/narrow.08 coding scope. Reuse zephyr.14 and admission.14 implementation/constraint ownership. This unit adds only experimental integration coverage and performs no ports, RF, filings or external communications.

Decomposition review correction: this leaf is the bounded station-policy producer plus its integration coverage; the earlier tests-only restriction is superseded. Driver support remains narrow.09, and human policy choices remain narrow.06/.08.
acceptance_criteria: Named station-policy implementation/reuse entry points exist before the integration assertions run. Independent traces verify identification/control deadlines, shutdown, overload and missing station configuration, denied traffic and mode rejection, with no RF calls on denial. Required scoped human approvals are recorded before implementing the approved experimental behavior. Production security and baseline profile remain unchanged; three independent reviews cover any source/test changes. No transmission or station authorization is granted by this task.
notes: Task-definition amendment after independent decomposition review. This commissions future work only; nothing was implemented or tested. The initial CLI-input fingerprint is retained as initial_scope_sha256; current native Beads fields are authoritative. Do not rerun the seed applicator over this reviewed amendment.
